exposure: antenatal group healthy relationship education program
Women with a nonanomalous gestation randomized at <40 weeks who received care and delivered at a single safety-net hospital and were discharged home with a live infant(s)
Antenatal group healthy relationship education program ('MotherWise')
outcome: Use of long-acting reversible contraception (LARC) postpartum
finding: Antenatal group healthy relationship education provided separately from prenatal care is associated with a twofold increase in the use of postpartum LARC.
mod_finding: Participants randomized to the healthy relationship education program were more likely to have a cesarean delivery.
